findings.title: Public diagnostics route returns a secret in an error message
evidence: src/diagnostics/diag.controller.ts:40-72 (route marked public; catch block interpolates the API secret)
findings.observation: An unauthenticated GET returns configuration details and, on an error path, the value of the API secret.
findings.impact: Anyone can obtain the secret and act as the service against the payment provider.
findings.recommendation: Remove the route, never interpolate secrets into errors, rotate the secret.

verification.note: read the handler and its guard configuration

findings.title: Booking records can be read and deleted across tenants by id
findings.observation: Get and delete take a bare booking id and never compare the caller's tenant.
findings.impact: A user of one tenant can read or delete another tenant's bookings if an id is known or guessed.
findings.recommendation: Apply a shared tenant scope to every query and use scoped deletes.

verification.note: no ORM extension or global filter found

findings.title: Checkout performs three dependent writes without a transaction
findings.observation: Order, payment record and stock update are committed independently.
findings.impact: A failure part-way leaves an order without a payment record or stock not reduced.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the operation in one database transaction and add an idempotency key.

verification.note: impact lower than first stated: stock is reconciled nightly

findings.title: Default branch does not require reviews or passing checks
evidence: repository branch protection API: no required review rule, required checks list empty
findings.observation: Direct pushes and unreviewed merges to the default branch are allowed.
findings.recommendation: Require pull requests, one review and the CI jobs as required checks.

findings.title: Setup guide references a removed service
findings.observation: The README tells new developers to start a service that no longer exists.
